actions.headline: Los Angeles Health Care Fraud Takedown Results in Charges Against 15 Defendants, Including 6 Medical Professionals, Nearly $2 Billion in Loss
actions.summary: Charges Include Largest Substance Abuse Treatment Fraud Scheme Ever Prosecuted by the Department of Justice The Justice Department today announced charges against 15 defendants, including six medical professionals, for health care fraud schemes that collectively resulted in over $1. 8 billion in fraudulent claims to government and private health care programs.
